subject: Admin activity evidence: window definition, sampling and transfer options
messages:
From: SOC2 Audit - CyberTrust <soc2@cybertrust.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Ops - GreenClinic <ops@greenclinic.org>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: [Request] Admin activity evidence: scope and export format

Hi Karthik / Laura,

As part of our SIG/SOC2 evidence collection for GreenClinic Health (control group: admin activity), we need the following to complete the access and change controls section: 

- A time-window definition for admin activity logs (what windows are retained and where).
- A description of exactly which admin events are captured (event name + fields) and retention policy (per-event retention if applicable).
- A 90-day export of admin activity in machine-readable CSV/JSON (if full export is not feasible, a documented sampling plan and how it maps to the full dataset).
- Delivery options: SFTP, encrypted S3 presigned bundle, or secure Share (please indicate KMS usage).
- A manifest file with HMAC/SHA256 checksums for all bundles and an attestable chain-of-custody note.
- Redaction approach: indicate whether user identifiers or IPs are redacted and the rules used.

If possible, please attach a small sanitized sample (10–20 rows) that includes column headers so we can verify field mapping. We need to conclude evidence intake by EOD 2027-05-11.

Let us know if this triggers any data processing or legal review. Happy to set a short call if needed.

Thanks,
Maya Singh
Senior Auditor, CyberTrust
soc2@cybertrust.com

Attachments: none

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: SOC2 Audit - CyberTrust <soc2@cybertrust.com>, IT Ops - GreenClinic <ops@greenclinic.org>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Request] Admin activity evidence: scope and export format

Hi Maya — thanks for the clear checklist. Quick plan from our side: 

1) Window & retention: our default admin-activity index keeps full event records for 365 days in hot storage, then we move compressed deltas to archival storage for up to 5 years (policy: admin_activity_policy_v2). For evidentiary exports we can produce a point-in-time snapshot (full CSV) for a requested window (e.g., full 90 days) or a rolling delta bundle (daily deltas + single manifest).

2) Logged fields: actor_id, actor_email, role_before, role_after, action_type, resource_type, resource_id, timestamp_utc, source_ip, session_id, request_id, payload_summary (truncated). If you need additional fields we can enumerate, but we avoid storing full PII in payload_summary by default.

3) Sampling: if a full 90-day export is too heavy, we propose a stratified sample: all privilege-change events + 5% random sample of console actions and key rotations, plus a time-stratified slice covering peak and off-peak windows. This maps back to the full dataset with documented sampling weights.

4) Transfer: we prefer encrypted S3 with customer KMS (or Redwood-managed KMS with envelope encryption) and a signed manifest. We can also provide SFTP over a dedicated endpoint. All bundles will include SHA256 checksums and a signed manifest (signed by our transfer service key).

5) Redaction & legal: we will produce a sanitized sample within 48 hours. For the full export we need confirmation on redaction thresholds (e.g., mask last octet of IPs, hash actor_email).

Im looping Ben (ops) for the manifest/checksum and Laura (legal) for DPA/NDA checks. If this plan works Ill schedule a short handoff call to confirm transfer endpoint and keying.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Director, Product Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed_export_options.md (stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, SOC2 Audit - CyberTrust <soc2@cybertrust.com>
Cc: IT Ops - GreenClinic <ops@greenclinic.org>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Request] Admin activity evidence: scope and export format

On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 10:30 AM, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Im looping Ben (ops) for the manifest/checksum and Laura (legal) for DPA/NDA checks.

Thanks Karthik — quick legal note: if the exported logs contain any identifiers that could reasonably be tied to an identifiable person (email addresses, user ids that map to real customers), we need a DPA addendum or the existing DPA signed by GreenClinic to cover processing and retention beyond the product contract. For the sample (10	60 rows) we can proceed without a DPA provided the sample is tokenized: replace actor_email with an irreversible hash and remove any free-text payloads that may contain PHI.

Please proceed with the sanitized sample delivery. For the 90-day export, we need confirmation from the GreenClinic security contact that they accept the transfer mode (KMS key owner) and the retention/archival terms.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Signature: Redwood Inference | 425-555-0199

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: SOC2 Audit - CyberTrust <soc2@cybertrust.com>, IT Ops - GreenClinic <ops@greenclinic.org>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 16:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: [Request] Admin activity evidence: scope and export format

Hi all — technical handoff with concrete artifacts below.

What we log (examples):
- admin_sign_in: {timestamp_utc, actor_id, source_ip, user_agent, request_id}
- console_action: {timestamp_utc, actor_id, action_type, resource_type, resource_id, request_id}
- role_change: {timestamp_utc, actor_email, role_before, role_after, admin_id}
- api_key_rotation: {timestamp_utc, actor_email, key_id, request_id}
- model_deploy: {timestamp_utc, actor_id, model_id, version, request_id}

Sample CSV (attached) contains header row and these columns: timestamp_utc, action_type, actor_email_masked, actor_role, resource_type, resource_id, source_ip_masked, session_id, request_id

Attachments (stubs included here):
- admin_activity_sample_20270504.csv (CSV, 15 rows; actor_email hashed, IP last-octet masked)
- manifest_checksums_20270504.txt (SHA256 checksums + manifest metadata)

Transfer details:
- Bundle will be uploaded to a pre-provisioned S3 bucket under https://redwoodinference.s3.amazonaws.com/secure-uploads/greenclinic/evidence-20270504/
- Encryption: AES-256 with customer KMS ARN if GreenClinic supplies key; otherwise Redwood-managed KMS with envelope encryption.
- Manifest format: JSON-lines (one manifest record per file) with fields: file_name, sha256, byte_count, generated_at, signer_id

Next steps:
1) Maya/CyberTrust confirm preferred transfer mode (S3 presigned + KMS ARN OR SFTP endpoint).
2) Confirm whether actor_email should be hashed or fully redacted for the full export (we can keep hashed tokens that are not reversible).
3) We will deliver the sanitized sample attached within the hour and schedule the full export for 2027-05-07 if you confirm.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Principal Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments listed above: admin_activity_sample_20270504.csv, manifest_checksums_20270504.txt
